spirit:component.spirit:name: sfap_pi
spirit:component.spirit:description: Two-element space-frequency power-inversion anti-jam filter (Vitis HLS): RX2 normalised to RX1, 256-bin sqrt-Hann WOLA filter bank with 50 % overlap, per-bin weight on RX2 plus 2 image (conjugate) taps, RX1 fixed at 1, exact bypass, output make-up gain, pulse blanker (cfg[27:16]) and per-bin excision mask (v6.3); weights and mask from the ARM via gnss_passthrough's weight RAM (memory ports). s_axis_x = RX1 and RX2 IQ, m_axis_y = filtered RX1, latency 782 samples.
